visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shows a blowtorch searing the sugar-coated top of a thick square of toast. A man with short dark hair in a striped rugby shirt takes a bite of the food. (2) A server's hands place a sizzling cast-iron pan containing toasted bread onto a wooden table. The scene cuts to shelves filled with various types of golden-brown brioche loaves. (3) The camera pans across the exterior of a shop, showing a giant decorative bread slice with a face in the window. Inside, the restaurant is lit with warm, orange-toned lights and filled with seated patrons. (4) The main man sits at a table, meticulously cutting into the toast with a fork and knife. (5) A montage displays paper shopping bags with bread illustrations and a printed menu listing different toast and soup options. (6) A thick, pale yellow custard-like liquid is poured from a white pitcher over the toast in the cast-iron pan. (7) The man walks through the wood-heavy interior of the shop, carrying a wooden tray with the prepared toast, a drink, and small side dishes. (8) He eats a piece of the original toast, showing a satisfied expression. (9) Honey is drizzled from a small white creamer onto sliced pieces of toast. The man takes a large, enthusiastic bite. (10) He dips a piece of toast into a small bowl of red berry jam. He is then seen holding a white cup with a straw. (11) The man talks directly to the camera with the restaurant interior in the background. The final shot shows the storefront at night with a glowing sign.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 今天帶你來吃. (2) [Subtitle]: 韓國首爾聖水法式吐司. (3) [Subtitle]: 教你不用排隊就可以吃到啦. (4) [Subtitle]: 韓國人真的很會把澱粉做變化耶. (5) [Subtitle]: 經典生吐司品牌直接變成了一間法式吐司店. (6) [Subtitle]: 這家分店在聖水開幕之後天天排隊. (7) [Subtitle]: 很多人早上災情頻傳沒有等一個小時根本吃不到. (8) [Subtitle]: 現在就讓我來跟你們分享我早上八點來. (9) [Subtitle]: 現場幾乎都是空位直接入座啦. (10) [Subtitle]: 映入眼簾的就是各式各樣的生吐司. (11) [Subtitle]: 店內有提供麵包外帶還有提供不同的果醬和抹醬. (12) [Subtitle]: 我們點了最經典的奶油布丁法式吐司. (13) [Subtitle]: 現場看他製作的感覺好療癒喔. (14) [Variety]: 哇 哇 哇. (15) [Subtitle]: 最期待的這個法式吐司. (16) [Subtitle]: 畫面超級療癒聞起來直接流口水. (17) [Subtitle]: 三種吃法一次滿足. (18) [Subtitle]: 第一吃先吃原味配上奶油感受吐司的綿密. (19) [Subtitle]: 這很好吃耶. (20) [Subtitle]: 第二吃加上蜂蜜直接給你最經典的法式吐司口味. (21) [Subtitle]: 加蜂蜜更好吃. (22) [Subtitle]: 第三吃酸甜莓果醬有夠解膩的. (23) [Subtitle]: 最後配上一杯奶昔今天就這樣完美結束啦. (24) [Subtitle]: 這家店如果不用排隊的話我一定還會再來很多次. (25) [Logo]: Standard Bread. [Slogan]: 快點傳給你最近要去韓國玩的朋友吧.
